title: Holomorphic differential forms on some orthogonal modular varieties
summary: We construct holomorphic differential forms of many degrees, including the minimum possible one, on the modular varieties associated to the even lattices of signature $(2, n)$ with $n\equiv 1, 3$ mod $8$ and discriminant $-2$ in the range $n\geq 25$. This is the first example of holomorphic differential forms of non-top degree on orthogonal modular varieties. The proof uses the Arthur multiplicity formula in the theory of automorphic representations.
